applies_to: VLT HVAC Drive FC 102 using the built-in RS-485 (FC) port with 8-30 Protocol = Modbus RTU and the FC control profile; parameter scaling checked against the software 7.61 programming guide.
summary: Danfoss's HVAC variable frequency drive with a built-in RS-485 port that can run Modbus RTU. Control word, bus reference, status word and main actual value sit at fixed holding registers 50000-50210, and every drive parameter is a holding register at ten times its parameter number. This map covers the control block, the communication and comm-loss parameters, and the main 15-xx/16-xx readouts whose conversion index is published.

addressing.note: Registers are printed 1-based. A parameter's register number is 10 x its parameter number (3-03 -> 3030, 16-13 -> 16130) and the request carries that number minus 1 (3-03 is read at address 3029 = 0x0BD5, per the manual's own example). The fixed process registers CTW 50000, REF 50010, STW 50200 and MAV 50210 follow the same minus-1 rule (CTW = address 49999). Coils are also numbered from 1 (coil 65 = address 64).

firmware: Programming data per software 7.61 guide; Modbus mapping per Design Guide MG11BC02 (software 3.9x)

source.title: VLT HVAC Drive FC 102 Design Guide 1.1-90 kW (chapter 8 RS485 Installation and Set-up, Modbus RTU)
source.pages: Design Guide PDF pp. 138-146 (printed pp. 136-146): Modbus setup, coil/holding register tables (printed p. 139), parameter access and examples (pp. 140-144), FC profile CTW/STW and reference scaling (pp. 144-146). Programming Guide 7.61 (AU430028034214en-001901): group 8 printed pp. 221-235, conversion-index blocks for 15-xx/16-xx in chapter 6; cross-checked with the 4.x programming guide parameter lists (MG11CE02, pp. 223-240).

notes: Scaling comes from each parameter's conversion index in the programming guide: -1 = x0.1, -2 = x0.01, -3 = x0.001, 0 = x1, 1 = x10. The 4.x guide's conversion table gives indices 67, 74, 75 and 100 the factors 1/60, 3600, 3600000 and 1 relative to SI units, so the transferred integer is already in RPM, hours, kWh and degC respectively (scale 1).

3-02/3-03 conversion index -3 is printed in the 7.61 guide and agrees with the design guide example (0016E360h = 1500000 = 1500.000 RPM). Programming data source: VLT HVAC Drive FC 102 Programming Guide, software 7.61, AU430028034214en-001901 (2024.10), https://assets.danfoss.com/documents/435027/AU430028034214en-001901.pdf.
32-bit parameters occupy two registers, high word first: the manual's example reads 3-03 at registers 3030/3031 and returns 0016E360h = 1500000 = 1500.000 RPM.
8-bit parameters (Uint8) are read and written as one 16-bit register.
REF and MAV are signed 16-bit values where 16384 (4000h) = 100%; with 3-00 = min-max the range runs from 3-02 (0%) to 3-03 (100%), with -max..+max it runs from -3-03 to +3-03.

Left out: 16-26 Power Filtered [kW] (conversion index 0 on a kW parameter; the 7.61 guide gives W as the base unit for 16-10, so 16-26's raw unit could be W or kW and is not stated), 16-23 Motor Shaft Power (index 1 with no stated base unit); 16-05 Main Actual Value [%] and 16-15 Frequency [%] (normalised N2 type); 15-30..15-33 alarm log arrays (need the IND pointer in register 9); text parameters. 16-10 Power [kW] is included because the 7.61 guide states its fieldbus value is in 10 W steps (index 1, base unit W).
Alarm/warning/extended status words (16-90..16-95) are listed as raw UINT32; their bit meanings are in the programming guide's troubleshooting tables.
Coils 1-16 / 17-32 / 33-48 / 49-64 mirror CTW, REF, STW and MAV bit by bit; only coil 65 (parameter write control) is listed separately.
The design guide's 3-14 example prints registers 3410/3411; by the x10 rule 3-14 is 3140/3141, so treat that example as a typo.
FC 202 / FC 302 use the same scheme but have their own programming guides; this file only claims FC 102.

integration.summary: Set 8-30 to Modbus RTU and power-cycle, make sure 8-02 points at the FC port and the drive is not in local/Hand control, then write the control word to 50000 and the reference to 50010 and poll 50200/50210. Read readouts from the 16-xx registers at parameter number x 10 (minus 1 on the wire).
integration.enable: Set 8-30 Protocol = [2] Modbus RTU (effective only after powering the drive off and on), 8-31 Address, 8-32 FC Port Baud Rate and 8-33 Parity/Stop Bits. Control word source 8-02 must be [1] FC port; 8-01 Control Site chooses digital and/or control word; 8-50..8-56 decide how bus bits combine with digital inputs (8-50, 8-55 and 8-56 default to Logic OR). STW bit 9 must read 1 (not in local operation) for bus control, and CTW bit 10 (data valid) must be 1.
integration.watchdog: 8-03 Control Word Timeout Time (0.5-18000 s, 0.1 s units) and 8-04 Control Word Timeout Function (default Off; options include Freeze output, Stop, Jogging, Max. speed, Stop and trip, set-up switching, Warning only). A valid control word restarts the timer. 8-05 decides what happens after communication returns from a set-up-switching timeout, and 8-06 resets that timeout when 8-05 = Hold set-up.
quirks: Parameter register = parameter number x 10, request address = that minus 1 (16-13 -> 16130 -> address 16129).
REF/MAV use 4000h = 100% of the 3-02..3-03 reference range, negative values in two's complement.

CTW bit 10 must be 1 or the whole control word is ignored. Derived from the bit table (these words are not printed in the manual): bits 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 10 set = 047Ch runs on the ramp; clearing bit 6 (043Ch) ramps to stop; bit 7 resets on its rising edge.
Uint8 parameters still occupy a full 16-bit register.
setup: RS-485 on the control terminals of the built-in FC port; set address 1-247 for Modbus RTU in 8-31.
Parity default is even with 1 stop bit (8-33); baud is chosen in 8-32 (2400-115200).
8-35 Minimum Response Delay can be raised for slow masters or converters.
Array parameters need the index written to holding register 9 before the read or write.
gotchas: Parameter writes go to RAM only unless coil 65 is set to 1; RAM changes are lost at power-down.
If 8-02 was changed to an option slot (e.g. after a fieldbus option was fitted), Modbus control words on the FC port are ignored.
Pressing [Stop/Reset] on the keypad or selecting local in 3-13 Reference Site blocks bus control (STW bit 9 = 0).
